title: Elden Ring Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 Location
description: Find Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 in Elden Ring, follow the route from Beside the Great Bridge, and unlock unlimited Somber Smithing Stone 9 purchases.
body:
**Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is in Crumbling Farum Azula, just below the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace.**

From the grace, turn around, take the elevator down, walk down the stairs and enter the nearby chapel. The Bell Bearing is on the corpse beside the altar.

Give it to the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold to unlock unlimited Somber Smithing Stone [9] purchases for 25,000 runes each.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Elden Ring item pickup screen showing Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 obtained beside an altar in Crumbling Farum Azula.
imageCredit: Screenshot: FandomWire / Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.

contentBlocks.text:
The easiest starting point is the **Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace** in Crumbling Farum Azula.

From there:

1. Turn around so you are facing away from the bridge.
2. Take the nearby elevator down one floor.
3. Walk down the stairs.
4. Enter the chapel ahead.
5. Loot the corpse beside the altar to get **Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5]**.

There is no boss attached to the pickup. Once you can reach this part of Farum Azula, you can simply collect it from the corpse.
contentBlocks.caption: Bell Bearing [5] is found on the corpse at the altar in this chapel below Beside the Great Bridge. Screenshot: The Nerd Stash; Elden Ring © Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.
contentBlocks.heading: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 exact location
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The altar room in Crumbling Farum Azula where Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 is found.

contentBlocks.text:
Take the Bell Bearing back to **Roundtable Hold** and give it to the **Twin Maiden Husks**.

It adds **Somber Smithing Stone [9]** to their shop for **25,000 runes each**, with no purchase limit.

That makes Bell Bearing [5] most useful when you want to upgrade several special weapons. If you only need one stone, Neural Critic's [Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations guide](/stories/elden-ring-somber-smithing-stone-9-locations/) covers earlier pickups that can be reached before Farum Azula.
contentBlocks.heading: What does Bell Bearing 5 unlock?

contentBlocks.text:
No. **The Bell Bearing itself is locked to Crumbling Farum Azula**, which is a late-game area.

You can still get Somber Smithing Stone [9] much earlier, though. Dragonbarrow has individual pickups that can take one special weapon to +9 long before you reach the Bell Bearing.

So the choice is simple:

- Need **one** Somber Smithing Stone [9] early? Pick up a loose stone.
- Want an **unlimited supply** for several weapons? Get Bell Bearing [5] later in Farum Azula.
contentBlocks.heading: Can you get Bell Bearing 5 early?

contentBlocks.text:
Yes. Once you give Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] to the Twin Maiden Husks, the unlocked shop stock carries into New Game Plus.

You do not need to collect the Bell Bearing again just to restore access to Somber Smithing Stone [9].

It does **not** unlock the final +10 material. Special weapons still need a **Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone** to move from +9 to +10.
contentBlocks.heading: Does Bell Bearing 5 carry into New Game Plus?

quickRead: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is one floor below the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.
Give it to the Twin Maiden Husks to buy unlimited Somber Smithing Stone [9] for 25,000 runes each.
The Bell Bearing shop unlock carries into New Game Plus, but it does not unlock the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone required for +10.
conclusion:
Start at **Beside the Great Bridge**, take the elevator down and enter the chapel at the bottom of the stairs. The corpse beside the altar holds Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5].

After you give it to the Twin Maiden Husks, Somber Smithing Stone [9] becomes available to buy whenever you need it.
